definitions.delta0: |m0 - ||P_S phi||^2|, exact missed weight of phi by the post-selected support S
definitions.rel_L1: int |A_S - A_exact| / int A_exact on the job's 600-pt grid, eta=0.15 (the B4 metric)
definitions.frac_le: fraction of reference replicas with value <= the device value (empirical percentile rank)
definitions.noiseless_raw_matched: (i) multinomial of the device's raw shots per circuit from the exact P_k
definitions.noiseless_retained_matched: (ii) multinomial of the device's retained shots per circuit from the exact P_k
definitions.noiseless_retained_matched_equal_split: (ii-b) as (ii) with the device's total retained shots split equally over the 7 circuits (retention_matched_control.py allocation)

phi_weight_stats.note: w_x = |phi_x|^2 is heavy-tailed, so Monte Carlo means of rare-miss Delta_0 are dominated by rare misses of heavy configurations; the analytic E[Delta_0] values in this file are exact

noiseless_infinite_shot.note: support of the exact output distributions (P_k > 1e-12): the shots -> infinity limit of (i)

lanczos_validation.method: Lanczos, full DGKS reorthogonalisation, m=300 (device rows m=400), vs stored exact eigh

noiseless_retained_matched_equal_split.note: same total usable shots as the device, but spread equally over the 7 circuits; the device instead keeps ~92% of circuit k=0 (a single determinant when noiseless) and ~12% of k=1..6

sd_over_analytic_sigma.analytic_source: data/_superseded/analytic_coverage_leak.json rows[shots].sd_delta0 (draws from |phi|^2 at the device's pooled kept N, Poisson independence)

uniform_noise_mixture_raw_matched.definition: per circuit (1-p) P_k + p/2^16, device raw shots per circuit, same post-selection

mc_check_missed_configs.note: the MC check uses the missed-configuration count (light-tailed); the MC mean of Delta_0 itself is dominated by rare misses of heavy configurations (see phi_weight_stats), the analytic E is exact
